training_data: CirCor DigiScope 1.0.3 (ODC-By), patient-wise split, 564 training patients
evaluation: 189 CirCor test patients: heart rate MAE 3.0 BPM (95% CI 2.5-3.6); S1/S2 found within 100 ms 96.8%/97.3%; murmur sensitivity 66.7% (50.0-81.8) against a pre-specified 80%, specificity 97.1%, AUROC 0.96. Not tested on Resondi device audio.
attribution: Trained on the CirCor DigiScope Phonocardiogram Dataset 1.0.3 (Oliveira et al., 2022, IEEE JBHI 26(6):2524-2535; PhysioNet), licensed ODC-By 1.0.
